reviewsInfo.customersSay: Customers find these coasters well-constructed and functional, appreciating their 4 different shades of brown/tan and their ability to absorb excess water effectively. They are durable, with one customer noting their stability in holding various glass types, and customers consider them a great addition to any living room, with one mentioning they work well with dishes. Customers find them worth the price and like their appearance, with one noting they're particularly attractive for the fall season.

reviews.reviewText: CUTE CUTE CUTE!! Love these coasters. The colors go very nicely with my decor, they are well made and should last quite a long time. I like that they are generously sized so that I can set a large cup of coffee on it, or even a giant soup mug which was unexpected but a plus. I also like that unlike other coasters I have used that are made of stone or ceramic, these are not going to stick to the bottom of a wet drink, then fall and scratch my table top! I will be ordering a set for my daughter!
reviews.reviewDate: Reviewed in the United States on January 8, 2026

reviews.reviewText: These are the perfect balance of quality absorbent drink coasters that withstands wear and tear and also is pleasing to look at. I appreciate that they can be washed in the laundry if stained and the brown palate colors I purchased are neutral warm colors. After purchasing, others who came to our house purchased them for themselves.
reviews.reviewDate: Reviewed in the United States on January 4, 2026

reviews.reviewText: Very nice coasters for a great low price. They are absorbent and do the job and have a nice rustic look to them. No issues with pinching from the holder and all the coasters are mostly uniform in thickness. Mugs and beer bottles balance fine on the coasters. Haven't tried wine glasses but the coasters seem pretty stable. I think the holder should have plastic or rubber feet so you don't risk damaging surfaces, but it's a really lightweight item so that shouldn't be a huge concern.
reviews.reviewDate: Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2025

reviews.reviewText: I really liked the colors and the material. They are thick and you can tell they are high quality.

reviews.reviewText: I was somewhat skeptical considering the price, but oh my gosh I absolutely love these coasters! I drink an iced coffee out of a 24oz mason glass everyday, so let’s just say condensation is a huge problem. The absorbency of these coasters is unbelievable. When I pick my glass up, the coaster is as dry as it was before I sat my drink on it. Others have been pooled and I have to dry with a paper towel after use. They are beautiful, extremely durable, slip resistant, don’t scratch my furniture, extremely functional, and hold large cups as well. I’ve spent $$$ on one single coaster, I can’t believe this set is only $8.99!! They’d make wonderful gifts! I’d recommend these to everyone.

reviews.reviewText: Perfect little coasters — sturdy, stylish, and protect the table really well. They’re the right size for my tea cups and look elegant too. Love them!

Finally found a good placement for my coffee! These look stylish, don't stick to your cup/mug/ glass. Very good value. And there's 8! Usually 4 or 6 on a set. I usually have yo buy 2 sets! Not this time.....well pleased with this purchase 😃

So far so good. Gets the job done. Needed them so condensation around the glass doesn’t make a pool of water underneath on the table and so far they’re holding up well. Also useful for hot mugs not to hurt the table under. As a bonus they don’t look too bad either.
